name: Peak Cavern
text: Peak Cavern, also known as the Devil's Arse, is one of the four show caves in Castleton, Derbyshire, England. Peakshole Water flows through and out of the cave, which has the largest natural cave entrance in Britain.

depictions.name: Peak Cavern
depictions.text: The Peak Cavern is a cave, west of Hemthorpe, in 9th century Snotinghamscire.
